[Go Back]
note: Faithful F5 BIG-IP ASM (Advanced WAF) block page (HTTP 403). The deny template ('The requested URL was rejected. Please consult with your administrator.' + 'Your support ID is: <id>') is F5-ASM-specific (no other vendor uses it), so it is the marker, gated by a non-2xx status. (BIG-IP cookies like TS<hex>/BIGipServer are the LB, present on allowed pages, not a block signal.) Sources: F5 ASM block-page docs, scrapfly.io anti-bot references.
